items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: I started working little gigs with a pianist named Bill Trigilia from Jersey and we had jobs

ctx.x: down there on Avenue B, right around the corner from Slugs. So, I'd get a chance to see just about everybody, everybody that had a group come through, they'd work Slugs. So I'd hang out at Slugs and see what was going on. It was pretty nice for a while and then it got to be very raunchy.

Well, all during this period, '67 -- no, about the first part of '68, I started working little gigs with a pianist named Bill Trigilia from Jersey and we had jobs, Playboy Club and over in Jersey and it was kind of what you would call a club date, bar mitzvahs and Knights of Columbia, you know, good gigs.
